entries.name: Mushroom
entries.style: low-poly chibi, painted texture flattened to flat colours (Quaternius 2020)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Not a numbered wave-1 row: an addition from the Textured Cute Monster Pack (Aug 2020) on OpenGameArt, the pack the library already uses for the ghost and demon, as a forest spirit for fantasy and yokai scenes. Its .blend expects Mushroom_Texture.png beside itself; the pipeline relinks it from the zip's Textures folder. The painted texture is flattened to 16 clusters: the five browns (cap top and gills) -> cap; the two creams (cap spots, teeth and the eye catchlights, which fall in the paler one) and the untextured #e7e7e7 -> spot; the five olive greys (the stem body and face) -> body; the near-black cluster (eye discs, mouth rim) and the dark olive cluster (lower eyelids) -> dark; the two plums (mouth cavity and tongue) -> tongue. The source's olive-grey stem and brown cap are recoloured to a pale stem under a vermilion cap with cream spots, so it reads as a toadstool at a glance; the spots are whole faces, so they come out as blocky patches, not round dots. dark has threshold -0.6 so the eyes stay mostly solid. Ground: like the ghost and demon it is a stem-shaped body on a flat base, no legs; Walk and Jump hop off the ground by design (up to 13 and 22 cm), Death sinks up to 11 cm as it tips onto its cap and HitRecieve 2 mm as it rocks, so both clamp to the ground. Height 0.8 m is a chibi choice: a mushroom spirit has no real size, and 0.8 m puts it at a child's height, matching the pack's ghost and demon so they stand together.
